allowAutoAnswer.description: Set to `true` to enable the Push-to-Talk feature.  When enabled, a workspace receives a Push-to-Talk call and answers the call automatically.

connectionType.description: Specifies the connection type to be used.

accessType.description: Specifies the access type to be applied when evaluating the member list.

members.description: List of people/workspaces that are allowed or disallowed to interact using the Push-to-Talk feature.
